passage.text: Hi, Nam! I'm at the airport now.
passage.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈnɑːm! aɪm ət ði ˈɛrpɔːrt ˈnaʊ.

passage.text: My flight is at 11:30 p.m., so I have two hours.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈflaɪt ɪz ət ɪˈlɛvən ˈθɜːrti ˌpiːˈɛm, soʊ aɪ ˈhæv ˈtuː ˈaʊərz.

passage.text: My suitcase is very heavy because I have a lot of Thai snacks for my family!
passage.reading: maɪ ˈsuːtkeɪs ɪz ˈvɛri ˈhɛvi bɪˈkɔːz aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈtaɪ ˈsnæks fər maɪ ˈfæməli!

passage.text: I'm going to land in Canada tomorrow afternoon.
passage.reading: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈlænd ɪn ˈkænədə təˈmɑːroʊ ˌæftərˈnuːn.

passage.text: My mom and dad are going to pick me up at the airport.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈmɑːm ənd ˈdæd ər ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈpɪk miː ˈʌp ət ði ˈɛrpɔːrt.

passage.text: I can't wait to see them!
passage.reading: aɪ ˈkænt ˈweɪt tə ˈsiː ðɛm!

passage.text: It's going to be very cold there, with a lot of snow.
passage.reading: ɪts ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə bi ˈvɛri ˈkoʊld ˈðɛr, wɪð ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈsnoʊ.

passage.text: I'll text you when I land.
passage.reading: aɪl ˈtɛkst juː wɛn aɪ ˈlænd.
